text: Rival II: Shadowlands Season 2 is a feat of strength achievement earned by reaching the rank of Rival II during Shadowlands Season 2.
Rival I: Shadowlands Season 3 is a feat of strength achievement earned by reaching the rank of Rival I during Shadowlands Season 3.
Rival II: Shadowlands Season 3 is a feat of strength achievement earned by reaching the rank of Rival II during Shadowlands Season 3.
Rival I: Shadowlands Season 4 is a feat of strength achievement earned by reaching the rank of Rival I during Shadowlands Season 4.
Rival II: Shadowlands Season 4 is a feat of strength achievement earned by reaching the rank of Rival II during Shadowlands Season 4.
Rival I: Shadowlands Season 2 is a feat of strength achievement earned by reaching the rank of Rival I during Shadowlands Season 2.
Rock Mace is a quest reward from Rite of Strength (Classic).
Rizz Loosebolt is a gnome engineering vendor located in a cage in Slaughter Hollow in the Alterac Mountains.
The Robes of Servitude are warlock robes that improve the wearer's stamina, intellect, and spellpower.
Robes of Silvermoon are a quest reward from Cleansing the Scar.
Robotron Control Unit is provided as an objective for A Dip in the Moonwell.
Roar of Recovery is a level 30 pet ability that allows the hunter's pet to roar, inspiring you, causing focus to return to the hunter.
Robert Richardson is a crewman of the Assurance found in Stormwind Harbor of Stormwind City.

Robert Gossom is a Forsaken found in the War Quarter in the Undercity. Alongside with Marla Fowler, Andrew Hartwell, Chloe Curthas, Richard Van Brunt and Riley Walker, he's cheering for Edward and Tyler.
__NOTOC__ Roberta Carter is a Forsaken cooking trainer that appears in the Ruins of Lordaeron in the Undercity during the Pilgrim's Bounty event.

Roar of Courage is a pet ability available exclusively to the cat family of hunter pets, increasing player mastery by an amount depending on level. It was functionally identical to the hydra family's Keen Senses, the spirit beast family's Spirit Beast Blessing, and the tallstrider family's Plainswalking.
The Robes of Smoldering Devastation drop from Beth'tilac in the Firelands.

Robert "Bobby" Kotick is the CEO and President of Activision Blizzard. Kotick and a partner acquired a 25% stake in Activision in 1990 and became CEO shortly thereafter and continued in this capacity after the merger with Blizzard Entertainment.
Roach Coach is a daily cooking quest available from Eunice Burch in the Trade Quarter in Undercity.
Rock Barrage is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

and some fungi.]] The Road to Stratholme, before becoming one of strongest front bases of the Scourge known as the Plaguewood, was a beautiful place like Elwynn Forest and had a town similar to Goldshire. Prince Arthas crossed the woodland in order to reach the city of Stratholme. In the small village here and nearby areas, you would find an unnamed inn as well as its residents, the majority of which are presumed to have fallen during the coming of the plague. When Kel'Thuzad began his work, the poisoned grain from Andorhal reached this area as well. Sergeant Morigan was the first soldier to realize that something was wrong.
Roark the Airwolf is an orc flight master located at Bladespire Citadel in Frostfire Ridge.

Robin is a djinn found in the South Sea in , south of Grommashar. When freed from his Ever-Burning Lamp, Robin proclaims "PHENOMENAL COSMIC POWERS!" before shrinking back down, adding "Itty bitty living space."
__NOTOC__ Robe of the Living Mountain drops from Mannoroth in .
Robotron 3000 was a harvest golem located in Whitereach Post in Thousand Needles. It is used during A Dip in the Moonwell.

Robb Glade is a human living in a cottage in Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains with his wife Ceya and their children, Robertson, Selya, as well as with his step-son Aramar. He is a blacksmith in the town. He left his own cottage and forge and moved to Ceya's cottage and built a new forge alongside it. He married Ceya after two years following her husband's abandonment. There were rough times with Aram and Robb at the beginning, but the boy eventually liked his step-father, even helping him in the forge. On his 12th birthday, Robb bought a sketchbook for Aram because he believed in his talent. When Greydon returned and asked for Aram to join him for a year, Robb agreed with Ceya that Aram needs

Robertson Glade is a human child living in a cottage in Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains. He is the son of Robb and Ceya. When Greydon Thorne returned to his former wife Ceya and asked for his son Aram to join him, Robertson was as angry as Aram and even threw a cup at Greydon's head.
Ro Ro is a butterfly being chased by Simi in Little Tortolla in Dazar'alor.
Roadtrogg is a trogg located in Bondo's Yard on Mechagon Island.
Robotic Gizmos are devices found on Island Expeditions. Once six have been collected, the A.T.O.M.I.K. Mk. II Razzle Dazzle will be constructed and placed at the faction boat.
Robes of Unreality drop from Prophet Skitra in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Roar of the Ocean is a quest reward from Legion world quests or is contained in caches.
Rock Lords are mountain giants located in the Firstborne's Bounty in Bastion.
The Robe of the Fallen Keeper drops from Ra-den the Despoiled in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
The Robes of the Nightborne Ambassador drops from Ambassador D'vwinn in the city of Suramar.

The Rogues' Quarter is located in the southeastern corner of the Undercity. It is home to many of the Forsaken's more shady characters, the rogues' guild, and a few profession trainers. Facilities: * Rogue trainers * Poison vendor * Leatherworking trainers * Skinning trainers * Engineering trainers * First Aid trainers
Rockscale Cod is looted from Feast Fish in Stormwind City. The item is also created by Cooking (175); taught by Recipe: Rockscale Cod.

Roguefeather Den is a small cavern in south central Thousand Needles, filled with aggressive screeching harpies. The harpies zealously guard their gathered foodstuffs in the back of the den. During the Cataclysm, the southern wall collapsed forming a ramp to the shelf above, but destroyed the entrance to the cavern and likely the cavern itself.

__NOTOC__ .]] Rohh the Silent is a rare gnoll found in Galardell Valley, Stonewatch Falls, or the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge Mountains. He is on a 10.5-16 hour respawn timer and is stealthed by default, only coming out of hiding when an enemy gets close.
Rocket-Chief Fuselage is a goblin quest giver located at Area 52 in the Netherstorm. He comes to Rustbolt on Mechagon Island when Ricket sent word that she was there.

Often a flagged player in the non-Battleground world will find themselves the ganking victim of a surprise attack by a Rogue. Although all classes gank at all level differences, people take exceptional note of Rogues due to their stealth, high damage output and escape abilities.

__NOTOC__ Rockjaw Bonesnappers are trogg mobs that can be found inside the Gol'Bolar Quarry Mine in eastern Dun Morogh. When the dwarves dug too deep, these troggs swarmed the mine, destroying equipment and trapping a number of dwarven miners inside.
__NOTOC__ Rogue Flame Spirits are fire elementals found in Stonetalon Mountains.

This article lists races that are able to become rogues, along with the lore behind each. As of patch 10.0 (Dragonflight), every playable race, with the notable exception of the Dracthyr, may follow the path of the rogue.
Rocknail Flayers are rock flayers found at the Netherwing Fields in Shadowmoon Valley.
__NOTOC__ Rocknail Rippers are rock flayers found at the Netherwing Fields in Shadowmoon Valley.
Rohemdal Pass is a mountain pass that can be found west of Frosthold in the Storm Peaks. Frostfeather harpies can be found here.
__NOTOC__ Rockfin Groupers are found by fishing in the sea around the continent of Northrend. It is not found in schools.

Rogue Wizards are human renegade wizard creeps that can be encountered in the Cityscape, Dalaran, Dalaran Ruins, Village and Village Fall tilesets. They attack with icy projectiles like the Lich and cast Frost Armor.

Rocket mounts are epic flying mounts that were introduced in World of Warcraft: The Burning Crusade. With Mists of Pandaria, two more rocket mounts were added, but are easier to obtain as they are crafted by players.
__NOTOC__ Rocket Jump is an active goblin racial ability that allows the goblin player to rocket forward a short distance in a jump-like motion using their Goblin All-In-1-Der Belt.

Rohash is a mighty djinn that commands the winds of the East. Rohash and the rest of the Conclave survived their defeat in the Throne of the Four Winds. They initially supported Prince Sarsarun to succeed Al'Akir, but were ultimately convinced of Thunderaan's power.

__NOTOC__ Rockjaw Goons are large trogg mobs found in Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh. Being the biggest and strongest troggs in the valley, they're the closest thing the Rockjaws have to leaders. They have made the assumption that the dwarves are responsible for the Shattering and, as a result, the destruction of much of their habitat.
The Rocknail flayers are a pack of rock flayers settled within the Netherwing Fields of Shadowmoon Valley.

It also appeared in the Reign of Fire set of the World of Warcraft: Trading Card Game.
__NOTOC__ Roffle's Ruffly Gloves are a random world drop from Cataclysm mobs.

The Rockpool tribe is a tribe of murlocs that was based at Rockpool Village in the Blasted Lands. They lived alongside the bloodwash naga for years, with little trouble between the two. After the Shattering the naga ransacked the murloc village, killing their chieftain and enslaving or slaughtering the rest. Only one adult murloc, Salt-Flop, escaped successfully, taking several tadpoles with him.
Roger is a human found fishing at Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains.
Rocketeer: Bronze is awarded for completing The Real Race at the Darkmoon Faire with the Rocketeer within 20 tolls, the second in a series of four.
Rocketeer: Silver is awarded for completing The Real Race at the Darkmoon Faire with the Rocketeer within 15 tolls, the third in a series of four.
Rocketmaster Malo is a goblin flight master located at Malo's Lookout in Tanaan Jungle.
Rocket Man is awarded for completing The Real Big Race at the Darkmoon Faire with the Rocketeer within 40 tolls.
Rocksnap Clackers are makrura located at Misty Coast and Rockaway Coast in Highmountain.
Rocksnap Elders are makrura located at the Rockaway Coast in Highmountain.
Rockaway Coast is the northwestern coastline in Highmountain.

Rocket cars are rocket-powered vehicles of gnome and goblin designs. They could be find at the Mirage Raceway in Thousand Needles, but nowadays only their wrecks remains. Their broken parts were still valued by the gnomes and goblins. Pozzik and Fizzle Brassbolts were rocket car builders and enthusiasts. Nazz Steamboil was a pilot of rocket car.
Rogg Shards are earth elemental furies located in Highmountain. They are summoned by drogbar.
The Rocksnap is a tribe of makrura inhabiting the northernwestern coast of Highmountain.
Rockfury is a mountain giant located in Vol'dun during Faction Assaults.
Rockjaw is an earth fury encountered by Class Order champions in Highmountain.
Rockmagus Bargg is a trogg located in Skittering Hollow in Island Expeditions.
Roggumsoggum's Boppers drop from Durguth at the Path of Huln in Highmountain.
Rockin' Rollin' Racer is a feat of strength achievement earned by being the proud owner of the 2021 Vintage winningter Veil gift, the Rockin' Rollin' Racer Customizer 19.9.3.
Rockin Research is an exploration achievement earned by destroying 100 boulders during the Researchers Under Fire: Titan Lockdown event.

Rokmar the Crackler, lord of the Zangarmarsh lobstrok resides in The Slave Pens. Somehow, Rokmar has grown to insane proportions for a lobstrok. The naga have somehow subjugated him into protecting their subterranean domain, or perhaps they have simply allowed him to remain and sate his notorious rage on intruders. If threatened, he will engage and kill any creature that does not belong in his domain by using his tearing claws and water blasting abilities.

__NOTOC__ Rokaro is a Champion of the Horde located at Shadowprey Village in Desolace. He is a companion and friend of Rexxar. When Rexxar departed Desolace to join the invasion of Outland, he left Rokaro behind in Shadowprey Village with information on how to obtain the :Drakefire Amulet and gain access to Onyxia's Lair. Myranda the Hag is familiar with Rokaro and seems to dislike him, calling him "as suspicious as ever". Rokaro was originally added to the game to replace Rexxar's role in the Onyxia's Lair attunement quest chain, after Rexxar was moved from Desolace to the Blade's Edge Mountains at the launch of . He later showed up in Razor Hill in Durotar during Azeroth's first Kosh'harg

__NOTOC__ Ros'eleth is a high elf quest giver located at Allerian Stronghold in Terokkar Forest. She wanted to send olemba seeds to the park of Stormwind City. She also tried to get Draenic vessels to lure high elves out of their addiction and Kael'thas's madness. Bertelm seems to have a crush on her. Ros'eleth followed the Farstriders back to Azeroth to join the Unseen Path, continuing her role as support staff.
Ronag the Slave Driver is a fel orc quest giver located deep within the Netherwing Mines in Shadowmoon Valley. He is friendly to players who have completed Blood Oath of the Netherwing.

Rolc was one of the draenei priests who fled from Shattrath City before it was laid siege to by the orcs. He later met up with Nobundo and several other survivors, who had by then already started their slow change into Broken. Rolc was elected the speaker when the uncorrupted draenei decided to keep the Broken away from the others, to live separate lives and avoid the condition spreading. This caused Nobundo to feel quite betrayed by Rolc, whom he had considered previously to be a friend.

Rolling Thunder was one of the most effective units in the Second War against the Horde. They were a company of Alliance archers supported by the tinker Alwys Cogspin. They rode into battle against the Horde in siege wagons. The "Rolling Thunder" was honored as one of the most effective units in the Second War.Magic & Mayhem, pg. 173

Rokir can be found in Malykriss: The Vile Hold. Vereth the Cunning wants him killed for the quest The Rider of the Unholy. His steed is called Plaguehoof. Assuming to his title, he's teaching Unholy Death knight abilities to the death knight adepts, similar to Lady Alistra in Acherus: The Ebon Hold.

A Romantic Poem is a token gift item given out by Undercity non-guard NPCs during the Love is in the Air seasonal event. These are combined into packages which are in turn hierarchically combined with other pledge packages for buffs and rewards. All of the Love is in the Air token gifts are non-functional as regards their name and picture. You cannot read a Romantic Poem item. __NOTOC__
Rolling Force Globe is a talented monk ability, available at level 90.

__NOTOC__ Rolf Karner is a worgen blacksmithing trainer located in the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus. He's most likely related to fellow blacksmithing supplies vendor Layna Karner. During the Burning of Teldrassil, he was seemingly evacuated with the civilians to Stormwind City.
Rosewood Beads are looted from the corpses of s at Moonwater Retreat in the Jade Forest.
__NOTOC__ Roman is human child found in Stormwind City hanging out with Justin and Brandon fishing in the Canals.

Rolo's Treasure is found overlooking the Ruby Lake, itself high above the Blazing Way on the northeastern end of Timeless Isle. The treasure chest ends a three-part quest chain that has adventurers find clues all over the island.

Rolkor is found in the obliterated remains of an Iron Horde camp at the northeastern end of Gronn Canyon in Gorgrond. Immediately north of the camp that Rolkor has destroyed at is an Odd Boulder. This boulder contains an Ancient Titan Chest.

Ronokon was an annihilan general of the Burning Legion who volunteered to oversee the conquest of Suramar during the War of the Ancients. The Wild God Ashamane faced Ronokon's army alone, ferociously thinning their ranks until the pit lord himself, enraged by Ashamane's intereference, was forced to step forth and personally deal with her. The Wild God and the annihilan dueled in the forests of Val'sharah for hours. Ronokon was a cunning fighter and knew how fast Ashamane could kill, so he kept his opponent at bay with his jagged, fel-wrought spear, content to inflict small, grazing wounds. After so much war, Ashamane's strength was beginning to fade, but her will was still unbroken. With the
__NOTOC__ Rosaine is a nightborne of Suramar City and a talented harpist.

__NOTOC__ Roland Abernathy is the undead companion of Aelthalyste. The two were venturing in Highmountain until they came across a tauren camp that had been wiped out by a demonic contagion, Roland fell to the same contagion and Aelthalyste called for help from the Conclave to find a cure. After being tested with the cure ---- and killed as a result, the High Priest resurrects Roland, now free from the fel sickness. Roland travels with Aelthalyste to help injured soldiers fighting on the Broken Shore and later joins her as they travel to Netherlight Temple to pledge themselves to the Conclave in the temple's Sanctuary of the Void.
Rooksguard Warboots is a quest reward from Spread Your Lunarwings and Fly.
Rooksguard Legguards is a quest reward from Spread Your Lunarwings and Fly.
__NOTOC__ Root-Hexxer Ib'aka is a blood troll located in Natha'vor in Nazmir. She is using blood magic on Immature Lasher Pods.
__NOTOC__ The Rolly Gulper is a water elemental located atop the spring at the Fleeting Forest on Mechagon Island.

The Rope of Friendship dropped from Hartli the Snatcher at Windripper Peak in Highmountain. With a 10 second cooldown, this item could tie a rope between the player and their target, making a whip sound when used.
Rorgog's Antenna is a quest reward from Powerful Conductors.
Rootwood Scarab is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Roots of the Dreamtree is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Rolling Tigers is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

The Root Home is an area of the dream tree of Tirna Scithe that is part of the grove, full of tirnenn. Huln Highmountain is usually to be found here. The entrance to the Mists of Tirna Scithe instance is located here.
Roll Out is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Swiftsure Wraps.
Rosewater can be found on Island Expeditions. It increases stamina by 5% for 5 minutes and heals 5% of max health every 15 seconds.

The Royal Apothecary Society (or the Apothecary Society, and abbreviated R.A.S.) is an alchemical society based in the Apothecarium in Undercity. It was created by Lady in order to create a new undead plague to wipe out the Scourge. Its members are all Forsaken or other types of undead beings who joined Sylvanas' cause. They are constantly brewing up new plagues and poisons to unleash upon Sylvanas' enemies. The other races of the Horde believe they are working on a remedy to cure their "illness". Members of the Apothecary society are called Apothecaries or Dark Apothecaries. Not even the noble steeds that succumbed to the Plague are allowed any rest in the hands of the Forsaken. Through an

__NOTOC__ :Deep in the depths of Maraudon lurks a great white crocolisk of myth. – Year of Fear calendar Rotgrip is a giant crocolisk boss that lives in the waters below Zaetar's Grave in Maraudon. Usually this mini-boss is done after Princess Theradras by jumping off the bridge that leads to her island.

camp and the barn.]] The Rotting Orchard is located in southern Duskwood—east of the Yorgen Farmstead, west of the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery, and southwest of Darkshire. The orchard has become home to many ravenous worgen of the Nightbane pack, who now occupy the orchard's dilapidated buildings and make camps, where the Nightbane Shadow Weavers practice their magic and Nightbane Stalkers keep watch in the shadows. The current packleader, Marus, patrols the area between the orchard and his den.
__NOTOC__ Royal Overseer Bauhaus is a Forsaken located in the Trade Quarter in the Undercity.
Royal Highmark Vestments is a cloth chest quest reward from Venom to the Undercity.
Royal Gauntlets of Silvermoon are epic plate gloves for tanks.

__NOTOC__ Rotten Ghouls are ghouls that guard or were just raised together with Leprithus in Westfall. They spawn in several places; *Under a tree a little southwest of the Jangolode Mine. The tree has a small square fence about it with some coffins within the fence line. *In the Dagger Hills, directly to the north and slightly to the east of the Deadmines' gates (in Stranglethorn Vale). There is another tree with coffins under it, here they will path back and forth from this location to the bridge to Duskwood, east of The Dead Acre. *In the Moonbrook cemetery.
The Royal Bank of Stormwind is one of two banks located in Stormwind City. This one is located in the Dwarven District and was added with changes made since the Cataclysm.

Raesa Morningstar is a dwarven rogue introduced in the third set of the World of Warcraft Trading Card Game. He has yet to appear in any games. Quotes from him and references to him can be found on the following cards: *"As if bein' encased in ice wasn't bad enough! How's a rogue to make a living?" - Molten Armor *"You just need to catch him to stop him, but good luck with that whole catching thing. He's more slippery than an Umbrafen eel." - Bitties
Rott Bonefinger is a Forsaken first aid trainer located at the Shattered Landing in Blasted Lands.

Rozzeleth is an annihilan who tried to flank the Nightfallen rebels at Meredil in Suramar and crush their army. He was killed along with his troops before he found the existence of Shal'Aran by the rebels led by Silgryn and an order leader. Already a powerful demon, Rozzeleth had absorbed a lot of Ancient Mana while stationed in Suramar. Severed from his fel form, his tusks hum with it.
Rotten Egg is an egg located in the Underbelly in Dalaran. When destroyed, it will hatch into a group of Mana-Engorged Spiderlings.
__NOTOC__ The Rotten Grotto is a large grotto in Darkheart Thicket. It has been tainted by the Emerald Nightmare, and the once-powerful druids who resided here have all succumbed to its madness.
Rotclaw Cub-Eaters are bears located on the expedition islands.
Rotclaw Maulers are bears located on the expedition islands.
Rotclaw Patriarchs are bears located on the expedition islands.
An unnamed crew of human pirates is present on the Rotting Mire during Island Expeditions.

__NOTOC__ Rotfeaster is a carrion bird located east of the Obelisk of the Stars in Uldum during the Assault in Uldum. This bird, along with a pack of Arid Bonepickers can be found feast on the remains of the Sand Pygmies that usually inhabit this area.
Rough Leystone Outcropping is a mining vein found in Highmountain.
__NOTOC__ Rotwood the Cursed is a saurok located in Island Expeditions.
Rough Leystone Ore is mined from the Rough Leystone Outcropping in Highmountain.

The Ruins of Zul'Mamwe is a troll ruin located south of the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound. It is surrounded by mountains on all sides except north. The second major troll tribe of Stranglethorn Vale, the Skullsplitters, inhabit Zul'Mamwe, led by their vicious chieftain, Ana'thek the Cruel. During the war against the Zandalari, these ruins were invaded by Jungle Serpents.

The Ruins of Andorhal are the ruins of the city of Andorhal, located in the center of the Western Plaguelands. The ruins are controlled by Araj the Summoner, a level 61 elite lich, surrounded by Scourge agents. The inhabitants are for the most part ghouls, skeletons, banshees, and abominations. Many players in WoW once regarded Andorhal as some of the most difficult (if not the most difficult) non-instance content in the game. During the pre-release beta, all of the mobs in Andorhal were elites, which practically made it an outdoor dungeon. For several months after the original release of WoW, Andorhal was very different than it appears in-game today. Although most of the mobs lost their eli

The Ruins of Ordil'Aran are located in northwestern Ashenvale, north of Maestra's Post and south of Bathran's Haunt. Although not much remains of the ancient city that once stood here, the site was a favorite spot for the Cult of the Dark Strand, who inhabited what is left of the ruins, ready to strike at any who approach. They have since been ousted by furbolgs of the Thistlefur tribe, who have taken over the ruins for themselves. Dead cultists still lie about the area. The Ruins of Ordil'Aran are also the site of the Heartswood tree.

The Ruins of Farahlon were once a draenei settlement, implied by Unbroken to have been a major site comparable to Telmor and Karabor. The ruins are located in northern Netherstorm just northeast of the Stormspire. A mighty dreadlord named Culuthas killed all of Socrethar's Burning Legion demons in the ruins and summoned his own void terrors called Hounds of Culuthas and beholder minions called Eyes of Culuthas. He holds an Ata'mal crystal, a powerful draenei artifact, which he apparently retrieved off the dead Burning Legion after they excavated it. Farahlon was also the old name of Netherstorm as a whole.

The Ruined Reaches form the southern coast of Azshara near the border to Durotar. It is mostly stretches of beach and cliffs broken up by inlets of water and dotted with various ruins and shipwrecks. Like the Jagged Reef to the north, travel along the reaches can be hazardous, both due to the treacherous shallows lying just below the surface of the ocean, but also due to aggressive murlocs, hydras, and makrura. On the western shores of the Ruined Reaches is a gnomish building on a hill (accessible by the main land down a steep path, not on the beach ) where Blimo Gadgetspring and Jubie Gadgetspring make their home and business selling engineering and trade supplies. If you ride the elevator

The Ruins of Baa'ri are located just northeast of the Hand of Gul'dan in central Shadowmoon Valley. They are populated by Broken and elekks in service to Illidan. They are the remains of Embaari Village.
The Ruins of Shandaral are the remnants of an ancient kaldorei city located in the eastern part of Crystalsong Forest, in the center of the Unbound Thicket.

The Ruins of the Scarlet Enclave is the combined region around the towns of New Avalon and Havenshire, which were destroyed by the Scourge (with the aid of death knight player characters). The Enclave is accessible by going through Tyr's Hand or the cave between the Noxious Glade and Death's Breach. Throughout the ruins, the banner of the Knights of the Ebon Blade (rather than that of the Scourge) can be seen in certain areas, such as the courtyard of New Avalon and outside the ruined Scarlet Hold. The ruins of these last human settlements in the Eastern Plaguelands serve only as a sad reminder of what the Scourge can do to its enemies. The Havenshire Farms contains a plague cauldron put in
Ruins are ancient, abandoned, or destroyed buildings or settlements. Ruins frequently become re-inhabited by creatures or races, most notably bandits, naga, ogres trolls, or undead.

Ruby Drake is one of three different drake players can ride in The Oculus. It is summoned via which the player may receive from Belgaristrasz after defeating Drakos the Interrogator. This vehicle allows players to assume the role of a tank. As players progress through The Oculus the drake gains further abilities.

The Ruby Sanctum is the red dragonflight's sanctum within the Chamber of Aspects beneath Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight. It is accessed via a crack in the ice following the Path of the Titans. It is a raid dungeon with both 10 and 25-player normal and heroic modes. The dungeon's release was delayed until patch 3.3.5a was released in Europe, a week after the US release, in an effort to make sure all players world-wide could access it at the same time. Even so, a large number of both US and EU realms were down for a 24-hour maintenance when the raid was opened.

The Ruins of Auberdine is the state of the Auberdine port town after Deathwing destroyed it and after the Battle for Darkshore. While partially rebuilt by the night elves in the aftermath of the battle, a large portion of the town still remains ruined.

The Ruins of Eldre'thar are newly discovered ruins of a Highborne city located inside Sishir Canyon. The ghostly highborne elves still haunt the area. The area is a night elf archaeology dig site and Nal'taszar can be found floating the lake's waters. Various conversations can be overheard among the named highborne ghosts.

Ruins of Vashj'ir are the ancient highborne ruins of the once-majestic city of Vashj'ir. It is the current stronghold of the naga within Vashj'ir. The massive ruins are found in southwestern Shimmering Expanse and are divided into three tiers: *The first tier contains various satellite ruins such as Quel'Dormir Gardens. *The second tier is Nar'shola Terrace. *The last and final tier is Quel'Dormir Terrace, which has the Quel'Dormir Temple in the middle. *Located to the east across a collapsed bridge, now known as the Severed Span, is Biel'aran Ridge. Many of the Highborne ruins in Biel'aran Ridge are an extension of the Ruins of Vashj'ir. According to a chain of flashbacks beginning with Vis

The Ruins of Taurajo (also spelled Taurajo Ruins) are all that remain of Camp Taurajo after its destruction by the Alliance. Following the burning of the camp, the tauren have constructed a high gated wall between the Southern Barrens and their homeland of Mulgore. The survivors, along with some of the survivors of Honor's Stand, have fled to Camp Una'fe ("Una'fe", fittingly, means "refuge" in taur-ahe) in the Overgrowth. Some other survivors left for Vendetta Point. While the village may be destroyed, the mailbox here still works for Horde characters. The Ruins of Southshore are all that remain of the human port town of Southshore, one of the last intact Alliance towns in Lordaeron. It is now controlled by the Horde and serves as a quest hub, complete with a flight master. Blight Slimes, Angry Blight Slimes and a unique ooze named Chet the Slime-Breeder infest the ruins.

__NOTOC__ The Ruins of Drakgor is a ruined orcish settlement located in northwestern Twilight Highlands. It was previously a town of Dragonmaw orcs known as the Drakgor Encampment. Despite its barracks and five watch towers, the settlement was destroyed after the Cataclysm by a force of Twilight's Hammer cultists led by Omak'Tul. They used Pyreburn Oil to set the buildings on fire and performed the summoning rituals of Iso'rath. Earthcaller Yevaa was captured when the Earthen Ring made an assault on the ruins, though she was later rescued by an adventurer.

The Ruins of Gilneas is a peninsula southwest of Silverpine Forest on the continent of Lordaeron. It is the name for the Gilneas zone after the events of the worgen starting experience. Horde players are sent here during the Silverpine Forest storyline. Otherwise, players will find the zone entirely deserted except for a few animals wandering about due to quest phasing. Between the Cataclysm and the Pandaria campaigns, the peninsula was abandoned. At some unknown point prior to the Fourth War the Forsaken were in the area again, and the Gilneans were shown to be mobilizing around the areas of the kingdom during the Fourth War. The Forsaken are later stated to still have troops occupying Giln

Ruins of Khintaset is an ancient ruin on top of the mountain in northwestern Uldum. The Maker's Ascent leads to these ruins, which lead to the Temple of Uldum. Schnottz is found here with his forces attempting to discover where the coffer is found. It's unknown what exactly this area was intended for in the days of past, but currently an Obsidian Colossus is found frozen in time in the center of the arena-like ruins. During the events of the Black Empire Campaign, the ruins were taken by the aqir.

The Ruins of Arkkoran are what remain of a once large ancient night elven temple known as the Temple of Arkkoran. It was the home of the sea giant Arkkoroc. The temple was completely destroyed by either the Cataclysm or the newcomer Bilgewater goblins, leaving no trace of the building but just the ruins that once surrounded it on the shores of Azshara.

The Ruins of Guo-Lai are the ruins of a mogu city in northwest Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Within the ruins are the still much intact Guo-Lai Halls, which contains many secrets. The ruins are mostly infested with spiders and ancient mogu statues, some of which possess life. A camp, built by the Golden Lotus, sits on the edge of the ruins and serves as a resting spot and quest hub. Golden Lotus Defenders can be found here protecting the small camp. The Ruined Passage is a stairway leading from the Pools of Power to the Golden Pagoda, which now lie in ruins apart of the Scarred Vale. Along the stairway is a massive button which unlocks the doorway that continues to the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Stomping on the button will activate a cutscene, which unlike the one in Throne of Thunder can be skipped.

The Ruby Crystalarium is some sort of famous construction in Shadowforge City, masterminded by Fenella Darkvire. The Crystalarium was impressive enough to have warranted a visit from Queen-Regent Moira Thaurissan.
The Ruins of Ata'gar is a destroyed Frostwolf village taken over by the as a base of operations while they preform rituals at the Icescar Boneyard and within the Gloomspire.
Ruined the Ruins is a island expedition achievement earned for achieving victory in an expedition to Un'gol Ruins in PvP.
Rufus is a retriever located at the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City.
The Ruby Life Pools are a dungeon in . It is the right of every true dragonflight to have their eggs nurtured by the Life Pools' waters.
Rugged Artisans are members of the Dragonscale Expedition located in the Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar, in Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City, and in the Waking Shores.
Ruby Embers is a Devastation talent for evokers. It is an exclusive choice node with Engulfing Blaze.

Rubyscale Outpost is a small outpost of the red dragonflight located on the eastern part of the border between the Waking Shores and the Ohn'ahran Plains. A ruined tower here contains an Etched Ancient Monolith. A Dragon Glyph required for Ohn'ahran Plains Glyph Hunter is floating above a bridge on the north side of the ruins.

Runecloth is a cloth item drop from humanoids in the 51-60 level range. It is rarer than Mageweave Cloth, but not as rare as Felcloth. With the introduction of The Burning Crusade, this item was replaced as the most powerful normal cloth by Netherweave Cloth, which was then replaced by other cloths in subsequent expansions.

The Runed Arcanite Rod is a tool used by Enchanters to help enchant items with new abilities. The rod is created by the enchanter and only he or she can use it. The rod is not consumed when used in enchanting.

The Runed Truesilver Rod is a tool used by Enchanters to help enchant items with new abilities. The rod is created by the enchanter and only he or she can use it. The rod is not consumed when used in enchanting.

__NOTOC__ You can train to create this item at a Grand Master Enchanter: * Asarnan in Netherstorm * Felannia in Hellfire Peninsula * High Enchanter Bardolan in Shattrath City * Johan Barnes in Hellfire Peninsula

The Runecloth cloth set is not a true set in that it does not provide set bonuses. The individual pieces have Intellect and Spirit, while the gloves have +Dmg(spells)/+Healing. The set bonuses make this set attractive to Mages and Priests. The pieces in this set span some 9 character levels and 40 levels of tailoring. Therefore, it is unlikely that this would be used as a complete set by level 56. Most of the pieces in this set are more likely to mixed with other armor pieces. Like the Cindercloth set, this set has 2 chest pieces: a tunic and a robe. Stats are given for each complete set. Vendored patterns can be found in Moonglade and Winterspring.

The Runed Stygian cloth set is not a true set in that it does not provide set bonuses. The individual pieces provide bonuses to Stamina, Shadow resistance and Mana regeneration (MP/5). The stat bonuses on these pieces make this set attractive to Warlocks. These patterns are a random drop from a in-game mail you receive from Hermit Ortell. They are mailed to you a few hours after turning in Encrypted Twilight Texts to him.

__NOTOC__ Runeweaver Square is a plaza at the center of Dalaran, set between the Silver Enclave and Sunreaver's Sanctuary. There is a fountain at the center of the square. Initially, after the first server kill of the Lich King, the fountain was replaced by a monument named Dedication of Honor, a statue depicting Tirion Fordring. However, at some point, the statue was removed and the fountain restored, though the plaque dedicating the Lich King's defeat remains. When the city moved to the Broken Isles this plaza was re-purposed into the Chamber of the Guardian.

Runic Wards are magical rune locks that need to be interacted with in certain order for certain chests in Drustvar to become lootable. In order to activate them, find circular plaques with the rune symbols around the ward (on the ground or wall), and click each symbol as they appear going from the leftmost symbol and clockwise to the rightmost one (just like Skyrim!). Clicking the wards in incorrect order will hurt you for 50% of health.

Rutherford Twing is a Forsaken PvP rewards vendor located in Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands. He is the Forsaken Defilers' Supply Officer, and he stands outside the entrance to the Arathi Basin in the north part of town. Horde players can buy special items from him with honor points and Arathi Basin Marks of Honor. Due to the level banding that occurs in battlegrounds, many of these items have multiple versions with the same name. For example, there are 4 versions of the Defiler's Cloth Girdle available at levels 28, 38, 48, and 58. Each one is more powerful than the next.

The Rustmaul Dig Site was an abandoned dwarven digsite in the Shimmering Flats. The Explorers' League was in the process of uncovering some ruins when a war party led by Moktar Krin attacked them, killing them all. The battle apparently stirred up a nest of silithid creatures from a cave in the dig site. The continuous swarm of insects that erupted drove the already weakened war party off. The surviving members of the Horde war party can be found at Ironstone Camp, while some did manage to make it to Orgrimmar. When the Shattering caused the flooding of Thousand Needles, the dig site was lost and the Silithid creatures borrowed underground. The area was renamed to Sunken Dig Site.
Rutgar Glyphshaper is a dwarf quest giver located at Bronzebeard Encampment in Silithus. He vanishes after Sargeras destroys Silithus and it is unknown if he survived the attack.

Ruul's Netherdrake is a nether drake that spawns when players kill Ruul the Darkener at the Netherwing Fields in Shadowmoon Valley.
